title: Special Repairs and Maintenance of Lighthouse Tower and Reconstruction of Powerhouse Building at Thangassery Point Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for special repairs and maintenance of the lighthouse tower and reconstruction of the powerhouse building at Thangasseri Point Lighthouse, Kerala, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Thangasseri Point Lighthouse, Thangasseri - 691 007
sites.work: Special repairs and maintenance of lighthouse tower; reconstruction of powerhouse building

scope.item: Special Repairs and Maintenance of Lighthouse Tower

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to be submitted by 10.08.2026 1500 hrs. Bid Securing Declaration listed among required documents.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two works each >= 50%, or one work >= 80%
Similar works: construction of institutional/office buildings, road/lighthouse tower etc. or other related civil construction works
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account officers in MoPSW or DGLL
Copy of EPF / labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
notes: Document is Section I (NIT) only, printed page numbers 2-6; no BOQ included. Hindi eligibility text on page 3 mentions generator shed with truss/concrete foundation/aluminium work among similar works, English text does not. Eligibility items 4 and 5 are duplicates (CA-certified turnover). Bid submission 17.07.2026 18:00 to 11.08.2026 15:00; bid query last date 27.07.2026 15:00; pre-bid 28.07.2026 15:00; technical bid opening 12.08.2026 15:00.
